subject_session: Achilles-10252013 (primary); + Gatsby-08022013, Buddy-06272013, Cicero-09012014 for replication

headline_stat.name: significant precessing fields with negative slope

stated_limitation: The single largest methodological trap is the direction convention. Because a leftward traversal enters a place field at the *larger* track coordinate, running the regression in absolute track coordinates yields slopes of opposite sign for the two running directions. An earlier version of this analysis did exactly that and found 19 negative and 24 positive slopes, i.e. chance, before the coordinate was re-expressed in the animal's direction of travel.

justification.dataset: DANDI:000044 (Grosmark & Buzsáki dorsal CA1, hc-11) is the canonical dataset for hippocampal theta entrainment and phase precession.
justification.handling: Real LFP and spikes streamed via LINDI, running epochs and direction-separated traversals correctly defined, with explicit and defensible unit-quality and place-field inclusion criteria.
justification.analysis: Kempter circular-linear regression, Rayleigh test, a 500-fold spike-phase permutation null, and cross-validated Poisson GLMs are all appropriate and correctly implemented with proper circular statistics.
justification.correctness: Every headline number (170/234 entrained, MRL 0.235 vs 0.157, 63/93 significant, 62 negative, -222 deg, rho 0.32, GLM 13/20 and 19/20) reproduces exactly from the committed CSVs and is internally consistent with the figures.
justification.figures: Figures are clearly labeled with units and sample sizes, show the effect plainly (tilted GLM ridges, pooled phase-position density), and example fields are ranked by correlation strength rather than fitted slope.
justification.honesty: Claims are proportionate to the evidence and the write-up names concrete limitations, including the direction-convention trap, the excluded sessions with reasons, and functional channel selection due to missing electrode locations.
